readThrough.concerns: Only L2 is in scope. L2 follow-up 언제쯤 breaks the whole-word allocation (언제/어디서/어떻게/얼마나). Native check: 대략 언제 올라오는지 is idiomatic (slightly more formal than 언제쯤, appropriate for a school-office exchange); it preserves the 'ungefähr/roughly' meaning already in the frozen baseText, so no base-text change is needed. Resulting learner sentence 그러면 공지가 대략 언제 올라오는지 아세요? = 6 eojeol, one sentence. Existing distractors 어디에/누구를/어느 분이 remain coherent near misses after 대략 (wrong question-word slot, grammatically parallel). Pattern rule already states 언제 asks when, so it now matches the dialogue exactly. L2 pattern example 2 uses 몇 시쯤 but is an example, not the learner line, and is frozen. L1, L3–L10 unchanged and not re-arbitrated.

openIssues: 대략 is not listed in L2 terms (terms frozen); optional future addition if the glossary coverage gate flags it.
L2 pattern example 2 (다음 수업은 몇 시쯤 끝나는지 아세요?) still uses the -쯤 form; acceptable as an example only, left frozen.
